meta.note: Setups parametrized based on transcript analysis; some parameters (gap %, stops) are author-recommended ranges converted to specific thresholds for backtesting

setups.name: DIP + VWAP Bounce Entry
setups.description: Buy pullback/dip near VWAP support, enter on bounce above VWAP with volume confirmation

price_vs_vwap.rule: price must be within 1-2% below VWAP to identify dip

vwap_bounce.rule: enter on close above VWAP with volume > 50k shares

momentum.rule: RSI(14) should be recovering from oversold (not < 30 after bounce)

time_window.rule: trade within first 2 hours of market open

profit_target_1.rule: first target at 5% gain, take 50% of position

profit_target_2.rule: second target at 10% gain, take 30% more

stop_loss.rule: hard stop at 2% below entry or break of VWAP

time_exit.rule: close at end of day (16:00 UTC) if no profit target hit

setups.symbols: all 8 (AMD, MU, WDC, SNDK, TSM, INTC, LRCX, STX)
source_quotes: Buy the dip near VWAP support
Enter on bounce with volume confirmation
Take profits at 5%, 10%, trail the rest

setups.name: Bull Flag Breakout Entry
setups.description: Identify bull flag pattern (consolidation after strong move), enter on breakout above resistance with volume

prior_move.rule: stock must have made 10%+ move in prior 5 days

flag_pattern.rule: consolidation in flag: range between 5-8% over 2-3 days

breakout_entry.rule: enter on close above flag high (previous resistance)
breakout_entry.requirement: price closes above flag_high and volume > 50k

profit_target_1.rule: first target at 8% gain, take 60% of position

profit_target_2.rule: second target at 15% gain, take remaining 40%

stop_loss.rule: hard stop at 3% below flag low (invalidates pattern)

time_exit.rule: close at end of day if no target hit

setups.symbols: all 8 (AMD, MU, WDC, SNDK, TSM, INTC, LRCX, STX)
source_quotes: Bull flag after 10%+ move and consolidation

setups.name: Scalp + Quick Momentum Entry
setups.description: Fast 2-5 minute scalp trades on intrabar momentum, tight stops, quick profit-taking

volume_spike.rule: volume must spike 3x average (sudden buying interest)

momentum_confirm.rule: RSI > 60 on 5-min chart, MACD bars turning up

entry_trigger.rule: enter on close above previous 2-bar high with volume
entry_trigger.requirement: price > high of prior 2 bars and volume spike confirmed

stop_loss.rule: tight stop at 1% below entry (scalp discipline)

time_exit.rule: force exit after 5 bars (3-5 min) regardless of P&L
time_exit.requirement: exit after 5 bars if still in trade

setups.symbols: all 8 (AMD, MU, WDC, SNDK, TSM, INTC, LRCX, STX)
source_quotes: Scalp on intrabar momentum, quick entries and exits

setups.name: Gap Up + Support Entry
setups.description: Premarket gap up > 2%, find support, enter on bounce with RSI confirmation

gap_condition.rule: stock must gap up > 2% at open vs prior close

support_bounce.rule: find first support (3-4% below open), wait for bounce
support_bounce.requirement: price approaches but holds above support

entry_trigger.rule: enter on close above support with RSI(14) > 40
entry_trigger.requirement: price > support and RSI > rsi_min and volume > volume_min

time_window.rule: entry must occur within first 90 minutes (09:30-11:00 UTC)

profit_target_1.rule: first target at gap close level (retracement), take 40% of position

profit_target_2.rule: second target at +5% from entry, take 40% more

stop_loss.rule: hard stop at 2.5% below entry (break of support confirms stop)

time_exit.rule: close at end of day if no target hit

setups.symbols: all 8 (AMD, MU, WDC, SNDK, TSM, INTC, LRCX, STX)

backtesting_notes.data_requirements: 1-min or 5-min OHLC historicals, volume data, RSI calculations
backtesting_notes.position_sizing: quarter to full position depends on setup, trailing stops where specified
backtesting_notes.risk_management: Hard stops enforced, no recovery trades, daily loss tracking
backtesting_notes.symbols: AMD, MU, WDC, SNDK, TSM, INTC, LRCX, STX (all 8 semis)
